title: Optimal Scheduling for Land and Water Attractions
description:
You are planning a visit to an amusement park and want to experience exactly one land ride and exactly one water ride. You can choose the order in which you take these rides (Land first, then Water, or Water first, then Land).

Each ride has an official opening 'startTime' and a fixed 'duration'. You can begin a ride at its designated start time or any time after it is open. If you have already finished one ride, you can immediately start the next one as long as it is already open; otherwise, you must wait until its start time.

Your task is to select the best pair of rides (one land, one water) and the best order to minimize the time you finish both.
input_format:
The input consists of several lines:
1. An integer n (number of land rides).
2. n space-separated integers (landStartTime[i]).
3. An integer n (redundant).
4. n space-separated integers (landDuration[i]).
5. An integer m (number of water rides).
6. m space-separated integers (waterStartTime[i]).
7. An integer m (redundant).
8. m space-separated integers (waterDuration[i]).
output_format: Print a single integer representing the earliest possible finish time for both rides.
constraints:
1 <= n, m <= 100
1 <= landStartTime[i], waterStartTime[i] <= 1000
1 <= landDuration[i], waterDuration[i] <= 1000
